title: Multi-Source Video Pipeline — Pexels + Pixabay HD Content
goal: Replace old silent IA films with contemporary HD stock footage from Pexels and Pixabay. Extend tiktok_briefs schema for multi-source support, add Pexels/Pixabay API clients, new source-brief-runner that queries stock APIs per topic, and update compose-runner to download from any source URL (no IA-only dependency).

tasks.description: DB migration — make ia_identifier nullable + add video_source / video_id / video_download_url to tiktok_briefs
pexels-client.ts — search Pexels Videos API, return VideoSourceItem[] with best HD download URL
pixabay-client.ts — search Pixabay Videos API, return VideoSourceItem[] with best HD download URL
source-brief-runner.ts — generates TikTok briefs from Pexels/Pixabay results per viral topic, stores with video_source + video_download_url
Update briefs-storage.ts — TikTokBrief interface + insertBrief support for optional ia_identifier and new video_source fields
Update compose-runner.ts — generic downloadFromUrl() for non-IA sources, route by video_source field, empty-transcript scene selection for stock footage
Update viral-topics.ts — add stock_queries field to TopicConfig for Pexels/Pixabay topic search

notes: API keys needed: PEXELS_API_KEY (pexels.com/api, free), PIXABAY_API_KEY (pixabay.com/api, free). Add to ~/kognai/.env. IA pipeline remains untouched — multi-source is additive. Next sprint (058): NASA Image/Video Library + Pixabay Music for background audio.
